contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 1
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the accepted TASK-0122 V7 dashboard implementation and its successful evidence; independently validate this rework.
Selecting a canonical Finding updates the URL authoritatively to /findings?findingId=<encoded validated finding ID> without inventing or changing Finding identity.
Selecting Dashboard through the visible Sidebar while a validated Finding context is active navigates to /?findingId=<encoded validated finding ID> and renders that active investigation.
Browser Back and Forward restore matching Findings or Dashboard URL, selected Finding context, Sidebar selection and rendered content.
Direct Dashboard and Findings deep links with a valid findingId remain URL-authoritative and refresh safely.
Dashboard without findingId continues to show the truthful compact No active investigation state.
Remove or hide the non-functional Dashboard Search findings control; do not present a search or selector unless it performs a real canonical Finding selection.
Do not introduce synthetic findings, evidence, analysis, provider execution, backend changes, a second routing architecture or broader lifecycle changes.

Add focused regression coverage for Finding selection URL synchronization, Findings to Dashboard Sidebar navigation, active investigation after navigation, Back/Forward, direct deep links, Dashboard without findingId and absence of the non-functional search field.
Run the complete frontend regression, TypeScript validation, production build and git diff --check; publish REVIEW only after every validator passes.
